cost: CSV O(B+cells) time/storage. JSON character parsing O(B), error position rescans prefix; key union and per-column row lookups can require O(rows*keys^2). json_text copies child strings at each nesting level: cumulative work is the sum of serialized subtree sizes, bounded by O(depth * output bytes), plus table/cell work. A depth-D singleton-array chain can require O(D^2) copying for O(D) output; recursion depth is unchecked.
description: CSV and JSON parsers, inferred table columns and matrix/value serialization without filesystem effects.
forward: CSV scans Unicode chars after leading BOMs, tracks line/column, decodes quoted fields and validates table width before inference. Numeric inference precedes boolean/date/text and quoted-present forces text. JSON parser preserves object member sequence; table conversion unions first-seen keys, picks first duplicate and fills missing null. Writers emit canonical bytes.
inverse: Quoted numeric CSV fields exclude numeric inference for their column; entirely missing column excludes text inference. J::Num and numeric-class nonfinite JSON serialization excludes numeric literals and becomes null; logical-class values instead use x!=0, so logical NaN serializes true. Successful parse_json excludes trailing nonwhitespace.

Canonical tables admit many CSV antecedents differing quoting, headers sanitized/deduped and numeric spelling. JSON table preimages include absent versus null and later duplicate keys. Vector JSON cannot reconstruct row versus column orientation or complex imaginary data.
limitations: Partial source-bound model, not semantic proof
Finite synthetic fixtures only; frozen suites/external measurement unexecuted
state: Numeric/date NaN table cells serialize empty CSV; write_matrix emits literal NaN through num_text. Numeric-class nonfinite JSON values become null, while logical-class values use nonzero truth, so logical NaN becomes true. Booleans with missing values become numeric; dates encode day values. Empty table CSV is newline and JSON is [] newline; read_matrix skips at most one nonnumeric header.
